capabilities: Create diagrams with ten built-in makers (Venn diagram, Punnett square, T-chart, number line, coordinate plane, scatter plot, dot plot, histogram, pie chart, line graph)
Edit diagram content before adding it to a note
Generate a diagram from a text description with AI
Save each diagram as a standalone .svg file in the attachments folder
Embed the diagram at the cursor in the current note
extras: AI generation is optional, off until a per-session consent tick, limited to 10 free successful generations per installation, and sends only the prompt and a random installation ID; no account, payment or telemetry is involved and the free makers run fully offline. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; privacy policy and terms live on svgdiagram.ai.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create simple diagrams and charts and embed them as standalone, theme-independent SVG files.
summary: Diagram maker that creates Venn diagrams, charts and graphs via ten built-in generators or optional AI, saving them as SVG files embedded in notes.
